shapeSummary: Simplified LIDAR-Lite v3HP: a 53.5 x 33.5 x 3.5 mm base flange plate with four corner mounting holes, a 40 x 24 mm block body rising to a total height of 24.5 mm, and two shallow 12.5 mm circular lens recesses side by side along X on the top face. The cable is not modeled.
warnings: Dimensions come from the unverified listed unit size (53.5 x 33.5 x 24.5 mm). The 24.5 mm height is placed on Y to follow the bottom-at-Y=0 rule, which differs from the axis assignment in the image analysis.
The body footprint (40 x 24 mm), flange thickness (3.5 mm), and mounting hole size and positions (3.2 mm holes at the corners) are estimated from the image.
The mounting holes are visible in the image but their exact positions are not measurable, so these are approximate.
The lens recess depth and positions are approximate. The lens glass, the body's stepped and sloped contours, and the notch between the lenses are omitted.
The cable and stripped wires are not modeled.
The flange ears are simplified into a full rectangular plate.
cadquery:
L=53.5; W=33.5; H=24.5; t=3.5
plate=cq.Workplane('XY').box(L,t,W,centered=(True,False,True))
body=cq.Workplane('XY').box(40,H,24,centered=(True,False,True))
part=plate.union(body)
lens=cq.Workplane('XZ',origin=(0,H,0)).pushPoints([(-10,0),(10,0)]).circle(6.25).extrude(1.5)
part=part.cut(lens)
holes=cq.Workplane('XZ',origin=(0,t,0)).pushPoints([(-23.5,-12.5),(-23.5,12.5),(23.5,-12.5),(23.5,12.5)]).circle(1.6).extrude(t)
part=part.cut(holes)
